messages:
elaine: Heads-up — competitor (OrchidAI) announced low-latency pricing; sales pushing parity asks from major accounts. Need quick alignment on scope and playbook.

mike_p: timeline? which features are they shipping?

elaine: Their PR shows streaming + cheaper tokens + a managed fallback model. Sales says customers ask for same routing policies and cheaper TCO.

kevin_s: from field: 3 enterprise prospects flagged this as blocker for Dedicated adoption. Want canary support + price guardrails.

ashok: parity on streaming is feasible but needs kernel changes + a week of infra work. KV cache improvements could be higher ROI.

marie: Product ask: decide parity on 2 axes: 1) Streaming semantics (chat streaming checkpoint), 2) Routing/cost controls (auto-fallback to cheaper variants).

jonah: propose matrix:
- Must-have: streaming with identical API
- Nice-to-have: autoscale cost-routing
- No for now: exact pricing match

elaine: +1. Also define launch criteria: end-to-end smoke, latency SLO within 10% of current, rollout to 10% of traffic, rollback plan.

ashok: perf note: to hit parity streaming we'd enable continuous batching + memory pinned kernels. Risk: small perf regression for short-seq workloads.

marie: Can we do a limited ship: streaming API compatibility + 'cost-mode: economical' flag that picks quantized variant? That buys time.

mike_p: estimate for dev + infra: 2 sprints product + 1 infra spike. Verified by eng-runtime.

jonah: ops ask: console changes for per-route cost SLO + tracing. Needed for enterprise demos.

elaine: decision: align on two-week spike to prototype streaming parity + a SC for 'economical' routing. If spike shows regression >15% to short-seq, back off.

kevin_s: sales note: will tell prospects we have a near-term parity plan; ask for commitment date when prototype done.

deploy-bot: @channel New spike branch created: feature/streaming-parity-proto (#3456)

ashok: assigning eng-runtime owners: @ashok and @sana to run spike. I'll follow up with kernel plan.

marie: I'll write acceptance checklist and update roadmap doc. Target: prototype complete by 1965620000.

elaine: thanks — can we sync tomorrow 9am PT? short stand.

mike_p: +1

jonah: +1
